posts.title: Annual meeting 2026: the budget, the vote and the coffee
posts.excerpt: What members decided at this year's annual meeting in the Riverside hall.
posts.content:
Over 400 members filled the hall on Mill Street for this year's annual meeting. The treasurer walked through the budget line by line, and members voted to keep every loan rate where it was.

Two directors were re-elected and one new director joined the board. As always, the coffee was free and the minutes are posted at every branch.

posts.title: What a sample rate means, and how to compare two loans
posts.excerpt: A short guide to APR, term and total cost.
posts.content:
An APR folds the interest rate and most fees into one yearly number, which makes two loans easier to compare. A lower APR over a longer term can still cost more in total, so look at the monthly payment and the total cost together.

All rates on this site are samples for demonstration. Use the calculator to try your own numbers.

posts.title: The Market Street branch gets a quiet room for appointments
posts.excerpt: A private room for loan and account conversations.
posts.content: Members asked for somewhere to talk about money without the counter noise. The Market Street branch now has a small quiet room with a table, a window and a kettle, bookable by phone or at the desk.
